name: Dynamic Adaptive Sampling Ray-Casting
aliases: Improved Ray-Casting Algorithm Using Dynamic Adaptive Sampling
ray-casting algorithm using dynamic adaptive sampling
definition: An improved volume rendering algorithm designed to address slow rendering speed and low sampling efficiency in 3D reconstruction of medical images by dynamically adjusting sampling intervals and using a new rendering operator.
summary: Dynamic Adaptive Sampling Ray-Casting accelerates volume rendering by dynamically adjusting sampling intervals based on voxel gradients and employing a specialized light-blocking composition operator.
